title: F-14B(U) CONTROL OVERVIEW
kicker: VKB F-14 GUNFIGHTER • SHARED UI LAYER • MODULE BINDINGS

items.text: VKB F-14 Gunfighter provides the primary Tomcat stick controls and shared UI Layer functions.
VKB_F14_BTN7 is the shared hold modifier used for applicable shifted aircraft and UI Layer functions.
MFD 1, MFD 2 and MFD 3 retain their module-specific functions and applicable UI Layer overlays.
Warthog microphone switch PTT is handled by the bundled AutoHotKey VAICOM bridge.
Warthog MIC forward / Joy6 -> Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Left Shift + 1
Warthog MIC right / Joy3 -> Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Left Shift + 2
Warthog MIC down / Joy4 -> Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Left Shift + 3
Warthog MIC left / Joy5 -> Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Left Shift + 4
Warthog MIC push / Joy2 -> Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Left Shift + 5
